name: Nova DRL Windows Engineer Client + Auto-Open Reports
operating_principle: 80/20 fixed default until Matt explicitly changes it

search_behavior.engineer_interface: type any full or partial identifying text at NOVA-DRL>

tracking_rules.customer_PO: display separately only when explicitly identified as customer PO
tracking_rules.DGK: Digi-Key order reference, not manufacturer PN
tracking_rules.MSR: Mouser order reference, not manufacturer PN
tracking_rules.NWK_DSK: procurement/order references; supplier unknown unless source states it

windows_engineer_client.name: NOVA DRL
windows_engineer_client.key_setup: one-time password prompt to authorize dedicated SSH public key
windows_engineer_client.search_transport: SSH with Base64-safe query; local index lookup on Nova server
windows_engineer_client.report_transport: server creates PDF -> SCP to Windows-accessible DRL share -> Windows opens local/shared PDF
windows_engineer_client.pdf_behavior: :pdf saves and auto-opens in default Windows PDF application
windows_engineer_client.print_behavior: :print attempts Windows default PDF Print verb; falls back to opening PDF for Ctrl+P

coverage.repair_knowledge: current frozen 10% benchmark corpus until further ingestion
